observation.happening: Meeting notes detail view showing transcript with metadata panels and tabs for transcript/notes/attachments/sources
observation.most_important: Clear hierarchical presentation of meeting data; tabs for filtering view types; minimal clutter with abundant white space
observation.next_action: Select transcript items or switch between tabs to navigate
anomalies: Substantial empty space below single transcript entry suggests either sparse demo data or oversized container proportions

C858.why: Polished, functional macOS app with clear structure and excellent whitespace. Navigation is evident, typography is clean, but the design lacks distinctive character—it's a safe, well-executed implementation without surprising detail or visual personality.

observation.happening: Google Meet meeting transcript overlay showing structured notes by category (decisions, action items, questions) with timestamps and speaker names
observation.most_important: Dark-theme transcript with readable text; categorized sections; timestamps anchor each entry to meeting timeline
observation.next_action: Review transcript, open full meeting, interact with categories
anomalies: No visual distinction between category headings and entries other than text color; line spacing could clarify sections more

CF92.why: Functional Google Meet interface for meeting notes. Readable and purpose-clear but typographically basic. Lacks visual sophistication—spacing and weight hierarchy could be stronger. Standard implementation without memorable detail.

observation.happening: Modal dialog for configuring a new recording session with microphone/screen audio selection, template choice, save location, and project assignment
observation.most_important: Modal is cleanly centered with well-organized settings; toggle for screen audio is prominent; dropdowns for templating and save behavior
observation.next_action: Adjust settings and click 'Start Recording' or cancel
anomalies: None apparent—modal proportions, spacing, and control placement are intentional

D2BC.why: Well-designed recording configuration modal. Settings are logically grouped, labels are clear, and the visual hierarchy guides focus. Polished execution but follows conventional modal patterns—no distinctive design language or unexpected detail.

observation.happening: Active recording state displayed with real-time counter (42:01), meeting title, action buttons to open live memo or stop recording, agenda below
observation.most_important: Red recording indicator with dot at top left immediately signals active state; time counter is prominent; calls-to-action are clear and accessible
observation.next_action: Continue meeting, open memo, or stop recording
anomalies: None—every element has clear purpose and placement

D3CB.why: Exemplary state communication. The recording indicator is prominent without being jarring; time counter is legible and well-placed; call-to-action buttons are immediate. The layout is calm despite showing active work. Craft is evident in spacing, alignment, and color choice. This demonstrates thoughtful design rather than template application.

observation.happening: Small loading/thinking state indicator overlay with minimal text and rounded container
observation.most_important: Conveys processing state clearly with single, actionable message
anomalies: Cannot fully assess design system or broader context from single loading toast

D9DF.why: Minimal loading indicator with appropriate restraint and clarity. Cannot evaluate system-wide coherence, motion, or interaction pattern from this single frame. Execution is clean but too small a surface to make broader design assessment.

observation.happening: Notion sidebar showing a page with AI-generated suggested actions (summarize, extract tasks, find decisions, ask questions)
observation.most_important: Section header 'SUGGESTED' clearly marks AI prompts; each action is icon + text pair; calm dark presentation
observation.next_action: Click a suggested action or navigate to page content
anomalies: Suggested actions feel generic—could be from any AI system; no Notion-specific personality evident

ai_look: Generic AI-prompt suggestions without tailored language or context; standard icon+text pill pattern common in AI assistants
E3C0.why: Functional Notion sidebar with suggested AI actions. Clear hierarchy and calm presentation, but the suggested actions lack specificity or contextual language that would distinguish this experience. Reads as template-generated prompts rather than considered interaction design.
